effects.name: V-Raptor
effects.effect: Place this on top of a "V-Raptor" you control to play this card from your hand. "V-Raptor-Aqua" can use the skills and abilities of the card underneath.

effects.name: Twin Slicer
effects.effect:
Apply one of these effects when you use this attack skill:
•Target 2 of your opponent's Vivosaurs with this attack skill, regardless of range.
•Use this attack skill twice on the same Vivosaur within this Vivosaur's range.
